title: Data Scout: Targeted Web Crawling for Domain-Specific Pretraining Corpora
abstract: arXiv:2609.05766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The dominant approach to building domain-specific pretraining corpora is to filter large web archives such as CommonCrawl. This works well for popular domains but breaks down for specialized ones, where relevant content is sparse and often beyond the reach of popularity-driven crawlers. We present Data Scout, which inverts this: instead of filtering an archive, it directs a targeted crawl. An LLM expands a root topic into a taxonomy and thousands of search queries; the returned URLs (seeds) are grouped by subdomain and screened with a user-supplied classifier (the probe), admitting each subdomain on the basis of a small sample. This works because relevance has a sharp boundary at the subdomain level: in mathematics, a page is 21x more likely to be relevant than one on a sibling subdomain. translated_title: Data Scout：面向领域特定预训练语料库的定向网络爬取
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.05766v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：构建领域特定预训练语料库的主流方法是对大型网络存档（如CommonCrawl）进行过滤。这种方法对热门领域效果良好，但对于专业领域则会失效，因为专业领域的相关内容稀疏，且往往超出了基于流行度的爬虫的覆盖范围。我们提出了Data Scout，它颠覆了这一模式：不是过滤存档，而是引导定向爬取。一个LLM将根主题扩展为分类体系及数千个搜索查询；返回的URL（种子）按子域名分组，并用用户提供的分类器（探针）进行筛选，基于小样本决定是否接纳每个子域名。这种方法有效的原因在于相关性在子域名层面存在清晰的边界：在数学领域，一个页面比其兄弟子域名上的页面相关性高21倍。以FineMath分类器作为探针，爬取的页面中有21.9%是高质量数学内容，是从可比网络存档中过滤所得0.31%比率的70倍。
tldr: Data Scout提出用“定向爬取”取代传统的“过滤存档”范式，利用LLM将主题扩展为分类体系和搜索查询，并借助子域名级分类器探针进行筛选，使爬取页面中高质量数学内容占比达到21.9%，是传统过滤方法的70倍。
en_tdlr: Data Scout inverts the dominant filtering paradigm by directing targeted crawls: an LLM expands topics into taxonomies and queries, while a classifier probe screens subdomains—achieving 21.9% high-quality math content, 70x the yield of filtering comparable web archives.
